((maponpaths
    (λ h : id₁ c · id₁ c ==> id₁ c,

 ! vassocl
     (linvunitor (id₁ c) • (id₁ c ◃ id₂ (id₁ c)))
     (id₂ (id₁ c) ▹ id₁ c) (lunitor (id₁ c))) @
(maponpaths
   (λ h : id₁ c ==> id₁ c · id₁ c, h • lunitor (id₁ c))
   (maponpaths
      (λ h : id₁ c · id₁ c ==> id₁ c · id₁ c,
